intro: The Supreme Magister directs newly arrived adventurers in Valanaar to Elaadrin Evengale, leader of the High Order. Operating from a lodge in the southeastern part of the settlement, the order seeks capable allies while navigating bitter friction with the Windshapers and the looming menace of a local cult.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid the High Order?
